frequency_question: How often do bilateral water-sharing treaties successfully achieve a successor agreement prior to or immediately upon expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal transboundary water treaties between sovereign nations that required renewal after a fixed multi-decade term. Excludes informal understandings or non-binding declarations.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty (Permanent mechanism, but operational modifications)

provenance_note: 2 cases named, 3 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.5x)
coverage_note: 2 named cases; limited strict analogues due to unique permanence of the 1996 Ganga Treaty structure.
known_gaps: Scarcity of exact 30-year bilateral water treaty renewals in South Asia outside the Indus and Mahakali frameworks.
skeleton: Bilateral riparian negotiation frameworks globally that reach expiration thresholds, categorized by political friction levels.
multiplier: 2 successful renewals / 3 major regional water treaty expiration events evaluated
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy norms in South Asia evolve slowly across decades.
